entities.summary: Andrew DePaola Jr. is an American professional football long snapper for the Minnesota Vikings of the National Football League (NFL). He made his NFL debut with the Tampa Bay Buccaneers on September 7, 2014. He played football and baseball in high school before playing college football for the Rutgers Scarlet Knights. He has also played in the NFL for the Chicago Bears, Oakland Raiders, and Carolina Panthers.
